Map of Southern Africa in the early 19th century showing the Mfecane migrations. A central shaded area marks the Zulu Kingdom under Shaka on the eastern coast. Several large arrows radiate outwards: one pointing north into Mozambique, one pointing far north towards Lake Malawi, one pointing west then north into modern Zimbabwe, and one pointing into the mountainous interior. The southern tip shows the Cape Colony. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
